answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity costly to earn: each agent must attest live transactions and answer a unique epoch challenge, so a hundred fake accounts cannot outvote a hundred real ones. Kin-linked clones share zero referral rewards, and unrelated peers cross-check every vote, so a forged fleet burns compute for no standing. A mirror pearl of honest work reflects trust back to its anchor, and proof rewards the faithful.
